content.short: Astar is a scalable decentralized blockchain for the next big Web3 innovations.
content.description: Astar provides a development platform for building dApps using both EVM and WASM smart contracts, enabling interoperability across chains through cross-consensus messaging (XCM) and a cross-virtual machine (XVM). Its Build2Earn program rewards developers for their code and dApps via a dApp staking mechanism. Today, the ecosystem hosts more than 50 dApps and serves a community of roughly 500,000 members.
content.meta: Astar is a scalable decentralized blockchain for the next big Web3 innovations. Discover Astar and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: How dApp Staking Was Rebuilt
resources.tldr: A fixed number of supported projects and simpler participation. What the revamp changed for stakers and for the teams being staked on.

resources.title: Where ASTR Actually Captures Value
resources.tldr: Ecosystem activity does not automatically flow back to a token. This lays out the mechanisms Astar is relying on to make it.

resources.title: Restructuring Token Supply
resources.tldr: Tokenomics 3.0, arrived at through community discussion rather than announced. What changes about how ASTR supply is structured.
